title: Banel & Adama
synopsis: Chaos ensues shortly after a young man in a remote village in northern Senegal refuses to accept his role as the new village chief.
awards: Bright Horizons Award - Melbourne International Film Festival
Best Directing Prize - Marrakech Film Festival

title: Maybe Elephants
synopsis: Three rebellious teenage daughters, a restless mother, a father struggling with potatoes, and maybe some elephants, find themselves in Nairobi. What could possibly go wrong?
awards: Audience Prize - Bucheon International Animation Festival
Best Nordic-Baltic Animated Youth Film - Fredrikstad Animation Festival
Best Animated Short - Canadian Screen Award

title: A Boat In The Garden
synopsis: I can tell you about my father's voyage on his boat, because I was with him all the time. It was a rather strange voyage, with no ocean or sea crossing, not even a lock to pass through... The boat stayed at home and so did my father. But that does not mean there was no adventure...
awards: Special Distinction Prize - Bucheon International Animation Festival
Best Animated Feature Film - Cartoons On The Bay - Pulcinella Award

title: A New Kind Of Wilderness
synopsis: In a forest in Norway, a family lives an isolated lifestyle in an attempt to be wild and free, but a tragic event changes everything, and they are forced to adjust to modern society.
awards: World Cinema Grand Jury Prize: Documentary - Sundance Film Festival

title: The Mohican
synopsis: Joseph is one of the last coastal shepherds in Corsica. His land is coveted by the underworld for a real estate project but he chooses not to give in. When he leaves the man who came to intimidate him, the godfather's own son, between life and death, he becomes the prey of a merciless hunt.

title: Tarrac
synopsis: Aoife Ní Bhraoin returns to her home on the Dingle Peninsula in the Kerry Gaeltacht to help her father, Breandán 'The Bear' Ó Braoin, recover from a heart attack. As they navigate their strained relationship, Aoife confronts the grief of her mother's death and finds purpose training with a local rowing crew for a prestigious naomhóg race.

title: Banjo Boys
synopsis: A documentary following the Madalitso Band. Featuring a live performance by the band after the screening.

title: Campeones (Champions)
synopsis: A disgraced basketball coach is sentenced to community service coaching a team of players with intellectual disabilities. Through his journey, he learns about teamwork, compassion, and the true meaning of winning.

program.venue: Lilongwe Girls School / Good Shepherd School (TBC)

title: A Happy Day
synopsis: Three teenage friends stuck in a frozen, hopeless place come up with a plan to escape over the mountain to a world where their dreams can be fulfilled. But when one of them falls in love, their plan begins to unravel.
awards: Best Director - Duhok International Film Festival
Best Cinematography - Duhok International Film Festival
FIPRESCI Prize - Duhok International Film Festival

title: Jippie No More
synopsis: Jaap Peter, a lively 16 year old boy, eagerly prepares for his older sister's wedding at their beloved grandfather's country house. As the whole family rallies together to create the perfect celebration, Jaap Peter falls in love for the first time. But when the girl of his dreams is smitten with his younger sister instead, Jaap Peter is disheartened. Through the chaos and tender moments, Jaap Peter learns that his presence and the unbreakable bond of his family are vital in ensuring the wedding's success.

title: Nuit Chérie (Sweet Night)
synopsis: During the Himalayan winter, a bear cannot fall asleep. He thinks too much and is in the doldrums. When a white monkey suggests him go to eat some honey at his aunt to change his ideas, a beautiful winter night opens upon them.

title: Living Large
synopsis: A 12-year-old boy faces bullying due to his weight and decides to take charge of his life by adopting a healthier lifestyle and trying to win the heart of the girl he admires. Through his journey, he learns the importance of positivity and standing against body shaming, discovering that true confidence comes from embracing who you are.
awards: Best Feature Award - European Children's Film Association (ECFA)
Jury Award - Annecy International Animation Film Festival
